title: Canonical etale and pro-etale comparison pullback data
statement:
Use schemes and chosen Cartesian squares [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], etale inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], the etale-to-pro-etale site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and pro-etale inverse images [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For a coefficient category $D$ with the small colimits and weak sheafifications needed for these sites, define the etale and pro-etale inverse images by left Kan extension followed by sheafification, with their canonical adjunctions to restriction. Define their identity, composition and chosen-square identifications as the adjoint mates of the corresponding restriction identifications. Define $
u_X^*$ by the same Kan-extension/sheafification construction along the inclusion $X_{\mathrm{et}}	o X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. For Grothendieck abelian coefficients this is definitionally $\mathrm{comparisonUpperStar}(D,X)$ with right adjoint $\mathrm{comparisonLowerStar}(D,X)$; for set coefficients it is the inverse-image (left-adjoint) part of $\mathrm{proEtaleSiteComparison}(X)$. Define the site base-change identification by the common chosen fibre products, and the direct-image comparison by restriction on those products. Define $
u_Y^* f_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}\cong f_{\mathrm{proet}}^{-1}
u_X^*$ (for $f:Y	o X$) as the adjunction mate of this direct-image comparison. Define the predicate $\mathrm{supportSiteComparisonPullbackCoherent}(D)$ to be its identity, arbitrary-composition, and chosen-Cartesian-square equations on every sheaf, using the specified identifications. No coherence assertion is made here.
